title: New workflow authoring through the installed workspace
summary: Continue the newly saved scratch workflow through type rejection, layout persistence, zoom and concurrent-save protection. No process execution or engineering review.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: New workflow
manualSteps.instruction: Choose Workflow files, then New workflow.

manualSteps.label: Author
manualSteps.instruction: Read the creation instructions, provide a name and create the verification workflow.

steps.label: Incompatible socket rejection
steps.summary: A connection diagnostic is visible and the semantic digest is unchanged.
steps.action: Try connecting Response output to its reference-file input using Enter.
steps.expected: Explain incompatible types without changing the accepted graph.
steps.actual: A connection diagnostic is visible and the semantic digest is unchanged.

steps.label: Dragging persists only layout
steps.summary: The node moves live; position commits on release and reopens exactly while semantics/revision remain unchanged; the full layout digest includes server revision metadata.
steps.action: Drag Text input, release, Save and reload.
steps.expected: Movement changes saved layout without changing semantics or definition revision.
steps.actual: The node moves live; position commits on release and reopens exactly while semantics/revision remain unchanged; the full layout digest includes server revision metadata.

steps.label: Canvas zoom controls
steps.summary: Zoom changes the canvas transform and all three controls remain reachable.
steps.action: Use Zoom in, Zoom out and Fit workflow to view.
steps.expected: Canvas navigation controls work within the editor.
steps.actual: Zoom changes the canvas transform and all three controls remain reachable.

steps.label: Editor continuation stopped at Compact two-times page scale
steps.summary: First unexpected state retained; no execution or review submitted.
steps.expected: Editor action succeeds without guesses or workarounds.
